Title: First-session funnel timestamps
Description: Add and standardize fund and checkout funnel events with timestamp metadata for share/gift velocity metrics.
Acceptance Criteria: New cohorts show valid median time_to_first_share and time_to_first_gift; no null fundId for fund-origin funnel events in normal flow

Title: Guided Launch completion telemetry
Description: Emit step completion telemetry from Guided Launch and track 48h completion metric.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin can report Guided Launch step drop-off and completion within 48h

Title: Checkout friction diagnostics by step
Description: Track checkout step markers and abandonment before session creation.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin diagnostics include step-level drop-offs and top abandonment step

Title: Lifecycle nudge queue to visible inbox
Description: Surface lifecycle-generated activities with clear CTA actions in Activity feed/detail.
Acceptance Criteria: Lifecycle activities are visible and actionable; no raw snake_case shown to users

Title: Pricing/entitlement consistency audit
Description: Unify pricing and entitlement copy across app surfaces and validate overlap/grace states.
Acceptance Criteria: No conflicting pricing copy; Starter->Family and Family->Starter states render correctly in Settings

Title: Fund details completeness in settings
Description: Extend fund snapshot with recency fields strategy and coverage status plus empty-state guidance.
Acceptance Criteria: Each fund card shows ownership and status without dashboard navigation

Title: Admin lifecycle signal cards and drill links
Description: Add drill actions from lifecycle cards to relevant filtered admin views.
Acceptance Criteria: Each lifecycle card links to a useful filtered context view

Title: Thank-you conversion loop scoring
Description: Track thank-you action within seven days and expose trend in admin.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin shows thank-you conversion and 7-day trend

Title: Share-after-gift prompt optimization
Description: Run post-gift CTA variant test and measure CTR plus downstream checkout starts.
Acceptance Criteria: Variant reporting exists and one winner is selected after threshold sample

Title: Event monetization decision clarity
Description: Improve Event Boost vs Starter vs Family decision clarity and usage path.
Acceptance Criteria: Multi-fund users understand best purchase path; support confusion decreases

Title: Unit economics trend panel
Description: Add 30-day trends for revenue estimated store fees and contribution margin with confidence labels.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin shows trend direction and confidence not only point-in-time values

Title: Retention reactivation outcomes
Description: Track and report recovery conversion for no_gift_14d lifecycle signals.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin shows reactivation recovery rate and sample count by channel where available

Title: Activity reliability hardening
Description: Make activity enrichment resilient and prevent hard failures from relational gaps.
Acceptance Criteria: Activity page remains functional with partial or missing relational data

Title: Outbound lifecycle worker
Description: Build idempotent lifecycle nudge email worker with cooldown and suppression logic.
Acceptance Criteria: Email nudges send once per cooldown window with safe retry/failure logs

Title: Fund health score
Description: Compute and expose per-fund A/B/C health score with rationale drill-down.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin fund table shows health score with explainable rationale

Title: Distribution source attribution model
Description: Normalize source taxonomy and attribute fund creation plus first gift by source.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin reports paid vs non-paid source contribution to first gifts and AFRG

Title: Guided Launch adaptive assistant
Description: Adapt Guided Launch CTA copy by incomplete step and lifecycle state with resume behavior.
Acceptance Criteria: Guided Launch completion lifts measurably vs baseline

Title: Weekly auto scorecard export
Description: Automate weekly KPI scorecard artifact generation without manual SQL pulls.
Acceptance Criteria: Weekly scorecard is generated automatically as CSV or JSON artifact
